title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 26
description:
Celebrate your passion for baseball with this custom bedding set from Jeminise. This comforter set is perfect for baseball players, fans, and anyone who loves the sport, offering a unique way to personalize your space with a touch of athletic spirit.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Ideal for baseball players and fans, celebrating determination and love for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques to hold dye and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Material Details: Whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing.
  • Custom Options: Personalization options include text inputs to make your bedding unique.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Sets
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Baseball Vintage Rustic
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
Closure Type Zipper
Pillowcase Quantity 2
